summary: Trip.com Group Limited filed a Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited second-quarter and first-half 2026 results, published September 16, 2026 (Hong Kong Time), as its Hong Kong Listing Rules 13.48(1) interim report for the six months ended June 30, 2026. The filing contains only a supplemental reconciliation of material differences between U.S. GAAP and IFRS Accounting Standards, with PricewaterhouseCoopers performing a limited assurance engagement under ISAE 3000 (Revised). No transaction, shareholder action, or structural event is disclosed; this is a routine periodic reporting filing with no deal terms, premium, stake, or closing conditions to assess.
